spans.s:
अव-कट (टः-टा-टं)
a. Opposite.
downwards, southern, backwards.

अवकीर्णिन्^1 (र्णी-र्णिनी-र्णि)
a. Vio-
later of a vow to be chaste.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अ-वक्तव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. Unfit to be
said; indescribable.

अव-क्रुष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
p. Badly sound-
ed; abused.

अव-क्लेद (दः-दं) 1.
m. n. Ichor,
fetid discharge; trickling.

अव-क्षेप (पः) 1.
m. Throwing wrong,
throwing down; irony, sarcasm.

अव-गण्ड (ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1.
m. A boil, or
pimple upon the face.

अव-गति (तिः) 2.
f. Knowledge in
general; departure.

अव-गथ (थः) 1.
m. f. n. Bathing early.

अव-गम (मः) 1.
m. Knowledge, cer-
tainty; removal.

अव-गीत (तः-ता-तं)
p. Revealed; de-
tested.
n. Blame, satire.

अव-गोरण (णं) 1.
n. Assailing with
weapons with intent to kill.

अव-ग्रह (हः) 1.
m. Seizure; disre-
spect; drought; obstacle.

अव-घट्ट (ट्टः) 1.
m. A hole, a cave.

अव-घात (तः) 1.
m. Threshing corn
with a wooden pestle and mor-
tar; striking; fatal blow.

अव-चार्य्य (र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
p. To be cast
down, given, applied.

अवचूर्णित^1 (तः-ता-तं)
p. Pounded.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अव-चूल (लः) 1.
m. The flag or crest
of a standard hanging down.

अव-चूलक (कं) 1.
n. A chowrie for
fanning away flies.

अव-च्छात (तः-ता-तं)
p. Emaciated
by hunger; reaped.

अव-च्छेदक (कः-का-कं)
a. Cutting;
distinguishing.
m. A predicator^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

अव-च्छेदा_वच्छेद (दः) 1.
m. General-
ising, removing distinctions.

अवट (टः) 1.
m. A hole; a well.

अवडीन^1 (नं) 1.
n. Flight of a bird.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अव-तोका (का) 2.
f. A cow miscarry-
ing from accident.

अवदंश^1 (शः) 1.
m. A relish.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अव-दान (नं)
n. Approved occu-
pation; breaking; achievement^1;
a fragrant grass; oblation.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

अव-दाह (हं) 1.
n. Root of a fragrant
grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)

अवदाहेष्टकापथ^1 (थं) 1.
n. Idem.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अवद्रङ्क^1 (कः) 1.
m. A market.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अवधीर^1 (त् क) अवधीरयति 10.
a. To
disregard, to despise.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अवन (नं) 1.
n. Satisfaction; preserv-
ing; kindness; going.

अवनद्ध (द्धं) 1.
n. A drum.
a. Tied.

अव-नाय (यः) 1.
m. Causing to de-
scend, precipitating.

आ-वापन (नं) 1.
n. A loom; a reel.

अव-पात (तः) 1.
m. A hole for catch-
ing game; descent.

अव-पीड (डः) 1.
m. A drug causing
sneezing, a sternutatory.

अव-बधा (धा) 1.
f. The segment of
the base of a triangle.

अव-बोध (धः) 1.
m. Judgment; being
awake; teaching.

अव-भास (सः) 1.
m. Light, manifes-
tation, illumination.

अव-भासिन् (सी-सिनी-सि)
a. Shining
bright.
f. Outer skin or cuticle.

अवभिन्न^1 (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
p. Broken.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अव-भृथ (थः) 1.
m. A supplementary
sacrifice; bathing after sacrifice.

अवम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Low.
n. Lunar days.

अवम-ताङ्कुश (शः) 1.
m. A restive ele-
phant, or one in rut.

अव-मति (तिः) 2.
m. A master.
f.
Aversion; contempt.

अव-मर्द्द (र्द्दः) 1.
m. Devastating, lay-
ing waste; giving pain.

अव-मानना (ना) 1.
f. Disrespect. Also
अव-मानं, अव-मानता, अव-मानिता.

अव-मान्य (न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
a. To be con-
temned, or disregarded.

अव-यविन् (वी-विनी-वि)
a. Limbed,
having parts.
m. A syllogism.

अ-वर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Posterior, younger,
inferior, not less.
f. Durga.
n.
Hind thigh of an elephant.

अ-वार (रं) 1.
n. Near bank of a river.

अवरार्द्ध्य (यः-या-यं)
a. Belonging
to the last half.

अव-रोध (धः) 1.
m. The seraglio of a
palace; a fence; hindrance.

अव-रोधक (कः-का-कं)
a. Impeding.
(धिका)
f. Concubine.
n. Fence.

अव-रोधन (नं) 1.
n. Seraglio; hind-
rance, obstacle.

अव-रोधिक (कः) 1.
m. A guard of the
seraglio, or queen's apartments.

अव-रोह (हः) 1.
m. Mounting; des-
cent; pendent branch; heaven.

अवरोहिन्^1 (ही) 1.
m. The Indian
fig-tree.
a. Descending.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अव-लग्न (ग्नः-ग्नं) 1.
m. n. The waist.
a. Placed near, attached.

अव-लम्ब (बः) 1.
m. Asylum, sup-
port, prop; a perpendicular.

अव-लम्बित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Protected,
depending on; quick.

अव-लम्बिन् (वी-बिनी-वि)
a. De-
pending on, hanging from.

अव-लिप्त (प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
a. Anointed
plastered, smeared; proud.

अवलीढ^1 (ढः-ढा-ढं)
p. Licked up.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अवलेप^1 (पः) 1.
m. Smearing; union;
ornament; pride.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अवलोकित^1 (तः-ता-तं) 1.
m. A Baud-
dha.
a. Seen, beheld.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अ-वस
adv. Without.
m. (सः) A
king; the sun.
n. (सं) Protection.

अव-शक्थिका (का) 1.
f. Bandage to
tie a person sitting on his hams.

अवशिष्ट^1 (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
a. Left, rest.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अ-वश्य
adv. Certainly.
a. Unsub-
duable.

अव-ष्कयणी (णी) 2.
f. A cow that
bears after a long interval.

अव-ष्टब्ध (ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
a. Near; sup-
ported; stopped.

अव-ष्टम्भन (नं) 1.
n. Supporting a
pillar; stopping.

आ-वसथ (थः-थं) 1.
m. n. A house; a
fire temple; a work on Āryā.

अव-सन्न (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
a. Dispirited, lan-
guid, bent; non-suited.

अव-सर्ग (गः) 1.
m. Following one's
own inclinations, or desires.

अव-सर्पिणी (णी) 3.
f. A Jaina division
of time, 10 crores of oceans.

अवसव्य^1 (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. Right, not left.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

अव-साद (दः) 1.
m. Lassitude, ex-
haustion; bad cause; end.

आ-वसित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Stored; win-
nowed, ripe, full grown.

अव-सेकिम (मः) 1.
m. A kind of cake.

अवस्था-चतुष्टय (यं) 1.
n. Four states,
or periods of life, childhood,
youth, manhood and old age.

अवस्था-द्वय (यं) 1.
n. Two states,
happiness and misery.

अव-स्थित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Occupying
place, engaged in; firm.

अव-हत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Beaten, bruis-
ed, threshed, winnowed.

अव-हस्त (स्तः) 1.
m. Back of the hand.

अव-हारक (कः) 1.
m. A shark, a
thief, &c.

अव-हालिका (का) 1.
f. A wall or fence.

अव-हित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Known, at-
tentive, done with care.

अवक-पुष्पी (ष्पी) 3.
f. A kind of anise.

अ-वा-ङ्मुख (खः-खा-खं)
a. Down-look-
ed; cast down headlong.

अवा_च् or अवाञ्च (ङ्-ची-क्)
a.
Down-looked; southern.

अ-वाच्य (च्यं)
n. Blameable discourse.
a. Vile, improper to be said.

अवा_वट (टः) 1.
m. Son by a second
husband, or another man.

आवन्त्य (न्त्यः) 1.
m. A degraded brāh-
man.
a. Belonging to Avanti.

आ-वरण (णं) 1.
n. A covering, shield,
bar, fence, obstruction.

आ-वरण-शक्ति (क्तिः) 2.
f. Power of
illusion or making invisible.

आ-वर्त्त (र्त्तः) 1.
m. A revolving; a
whirlpool; reflexion; horse's
mane curled backward; pyrites.

आ-वर्त्तका (का)
Idem. (की) 3.
f. The
name of a creeping plant.

आ-वर्त्तन (नं) 1.
n. Turning; stir-
ring any thing; infusion; invert-
ed shadow; repetition; study.
(नी) 3.
f. A crucible.

आ-वर्त्तन-मणि (णिः) 2.
m. A gem
of a secondary order.

आ-वर्त्तनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. To be turn-
ed round, reversed or repeated.

आ-वलि (लिः) 2.
f. A row or range.

आ-वाल्य (ल्यं) 1.
n. Age ending with
infancy; beginning of youth.

आ-वह (हः-हा-हं)
a. Bearing, con-
veying.
m. One of seven winds.

आ-वाप (पः) 1.
m. A basin for water
at the root of a tree; a brace-
let; sowing; hostile purpose;
a vessel; a sacrifice by fire.

अवतार-भेद (दः) 1.
m. A variety
or number of incarnations.

अव-तीर्णर्ण (र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
a. Free from
debt or obligation.

अवरुद्ध-देह (हः-ही-हं)
a. Enclosed
in a body, incarnate, incarcerat-
ed.

अव-रुरुत्समान (नः-ना-नं)
a. Desirous
of obtaining or alighting.

अवस्तु-दृश् (क्)
a. Regarding as no-
thing.

अव-हित-करण-कलाप (पः-पा-पं)
a.
Having all the senses at rest;
imperturbable.
